title: Declared-required notices, retired-hint, and checkbox-gate render contract has no automated test
evidence:
guarantor.gleam renders the notice with the conditional wiring the engine keys on:
      html.p(
        [
          attribute.class("guarantor-required-notice conditional-field"),
          attribute("data-testid", "guarantor-required-notice-first-rental"),
          attribute("data-condition", "_guarantor_cohort"),
          attribute("data-condition-value", "first_rental"),
        ],
        [html.text(form_copy.guarantor_required_notice_first_rental)],
      ),
and the checkbox-gate div:
      html.div(
        [
          attribute.class("conditional-field"),
          attribute("data-condition", "_guarantor_required"),
          attribute("data-condition-value", ""),
        ],
        [ common.view_checkbox_field(name: "has_guarantor", ...) ],
      ),
but guarantor_section_test.gleam never_rented_values_render_required_without_pretick_test asserts only the synthetics + checkbox-not-checked:
pub fn never_rented_values_render_required_without_pretick_test() {
  let html = render([#("never_rented_before", "on")])
  html |> synthetic("_guarantor_cohort", "first_rental") |> should.be_true
  html |> synthetic("_guarantor_required", "on") |> should.be_true
  html |> synthetic("_guarantor_fields_open", "on") |> should.be_true
  html |> string.contains(checked_shape) |> should.be_false
}
grep across server/test + scripts/ for guarantor-required-notice|guarantor-retired-hint|data-condition.*_guarantor_required returns ZERO matches, while the structurally-identical ahead-notes ARE pinned in form_view_test.gleam:
  "data-condition=\"never_rented_before\" data-condition-value=\"on\" data-testid=\"guarantor-ahead-note-first-rental\"".
bug-hunt (the only place these are asserted) is not in CI: grep bug-hunt .github/workflows/ returns nothing.
detail: The new section test pins only the _guarantor_* synthetic inputs and checkbox state. The notice/hint/checkbox-gate data-condition wiring — core to the declared-required UX — is covered only by manual bug-hunt E2E, which is not in CI.
recommended_fix: Add string.contains assertions for data-testid="guarantor-required-notice-first-rental" (and student/unemployed/retired-hint) plus the checkbox-gate div's data-condition="_guarantor_required" in guarantor_section_test.gleam.
